name: MERLIN OSCAR – Black
summary: The Oscar RO Water Purifier features advanced RO + UV + Alkaline + Copper + Zinc purification technology to deliver safe, healthy, and mineral-rich drinking water.
intro: The OSCAR Merlin 100 GPD is an advanced RO water purification system designed for brackish water. It combines RO, UV, Alkaline, Copper and Zinc purification technologies to deliver safe, purified and mineral-enriched drinking water. With a 10-litre storage tank and purification capacity of 12 LPH, it is well suited for domestic applications.
features: 100 GPD RO membrane for effective purification
7-stage filtration: Sediment, Pre-Carbon, RO, Post-Carbon, UV, Alkaline, Copper & Zinc
Supports inlet TDS up to 3000 PPM
